SELECT t_depot.id, t_depot.`status`, t_depot.depot_no AS depotNo, t_depot.depot_name AS depotName, t_depot.is_port AS isPort, t_depot.is_transit AS isTransit, t_depot.depot_address AS depotAddress, t_depot.manager, t_depot.manager_telephone AS managerTelephone FROM t_depot WHERE t_depot.is_deleted = #{param.deleted}
AND t_depot.`status` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.status}, '%')
AND t_depot.depot_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.depotNo}, '%')
AND t_depot.depot_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.depotName}, '%')
AND t_depot.is_port LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.isPort}, '%')
AND t_depot.is_transit LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.isTransit}, '%')
AND t_depot.depot_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.depotAddress}, '%')
AND t_depot.manager LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.manager}, '%')
AND t_depot.manager_telephone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.managerTelephone}, '%')
AND t_depot.id NOT IN
#{id}
ORDER BY t_depot.depot_orders ASC

SELECT t_depot.id, t_depot.status AS status, t_depot.depot_no AS depotNo, t_depot.depot_name AS depotName, t_depot.depot_orders AS depotOrders, t_depot.is_port AS isPort, t_depot.is_transit AS isTransit, t_depot.manager AS manager, t_depot.manager_telephone AS managerTelephone, t_depot.parent_id AS parentId FROM t_depot WHERE t_depot.is_deleted = 0 AND t_depot.parent_id = #{parentId}
